document.abstract: This paper is designed to inform members of the Society of the capabilities of students to actively function within the motion-picture field. The paper concerns the uniqueness, description and functions of a positive, black-and-white film processor built by University of Miami motion-picture students. The machine is capable of operating normally at 100 ft/min, and utilizes glass fiber, polyester resins and synthetic plastics throughout its construction. The processor is now in use for all University positive and soundtrack processing.
